datasets.name: Iburi-Tobu region satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: In this study, the satellite imagery of the Iburi-Tobu region was sourced from the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan37... Japan, G. Hokkaido iburi-tobu earthquake. http://www.gsi.go.jp/BOUSAI/H30-hokkaidoiburi-east-earthquake-index.html (2018).

methods.name: ResM-FusionNet
methods.summary: A deep learning-based landslide detection model that combines a ResNet-50 backbone for feature extraction with a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) decoder for pixel-level classification and detail recovery, trained using a custom loss function called RLoss.
methods.verbatim: The datasets generated and/or analysed during the current study are available in this repository https://github.com/Aizu0/CAS-Landslide-Dataset-production-code.
